spans.s:
ऐक्षव a. (वी f.) [इक्षु-अण्] Made
of, or produced from, sugar cane,
sugary.
--वं
1 Sugar.
--2 A kind of
spirituous liquor.
ऐक्षव्य a. Made of sugar cane.

ऐक्षुक a. [इक्षु-ठञ्]
1 Suitable for
sugar-cane.
--2 Bearing sugar-cane.
--कः A carrier of sugar-cane.

ऐक्षुभारिक a. [इक्षुभार-ठञ्]
Carrying a load of sugar-canes.

ऐक्ष्वाक a. [इक्ष्वाकु-अण्]
Belonging to Ikṣvāku.
--कः, --कुः
1 A
descendant of Ikṣvāku;
सत्यमैक्ष्वाकः खल्वसि

.
--2 The country
ruled by the Aikṣvākus.
